title: Verify download of a missing/deleted file
steps: Attempt to download a file that has been removed from the server.
expected_result: An error message is displayed (e.g., "File not found") rather than a corrupted file.

title: Verify download with no internet connectivity
expected_result: The browser handles the interruption gracefully (pauses or gives a network error) without crashing.

title: Verify download for unauthorized user
steps: Log in as a user without download permissions.
Attempt to click the download link.
expected_result: Access denied error or button is disabled

title: Verify successful download of a PDF document
steps: Click on the "Download" button for a PDF file.
expected_result: The PDF file downloads successfully, is not corrupted, and content matches the server version.

title: Verify download functionality for different file types
steps: Click download for .zip, .csv, and .docx files respectively.
expected_result: All file types download with correct extensions and file sizes.

title: Verify download with special characters in file name
expected_result: File downloads without errors, and the filename is preserved.

title: Verify download for large files
steps: Click download for a large file (>100MB).
expected_result: The browser does not time out; a progress indicator appears.

title: Verify multiple simultaneous downloads
steps: Click download on three different files at the same time.
expected_result: All files download successfully without corrupting each other.
